title: A low-cost cellulose-based composite as an efficient solid phase extraction sorbent for the determination of antibiotics in water
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32796-32809
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02296G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Damilare Olorunnisola, Chidinma G. Olorunnisola, Christina Günter, Chukwunonso P. Okoli, Martins O. Omorogie, Emmanuel I. Unuabonah, Harshadrai M. Rawel, Andreas Taubert
A low-cost, cellulose-based solid-phase extraction adsorbent (C/PVPP/MDI) for the determination of five antibiotics (tetracycline, ampicillin, sulfamethoxazole, penicillin V, and chloramphenicol) in water is presented.
